info.Title: Extension of Shri Sunil J Singhi, Chairperson, National Traders' Welfare Board

text: No. P-55015/2/2019-Internal Trade Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (Internal Trade and e-commerce Section) ***** Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi Dated: 27 May, 2025 ORDER In pursuance of the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade's order dated 19.06.2023, the Central Government hereby extends the term of Shri Sunil Jeevrajji Singhi, Chairperson, National Traders' Welfare Board for a period of two years from 18.06.2025 or until further order, whichever is earlier. /(Jitender Juyal) Under Secretary to the Government of India 1. Chairperson and Members, National Traders' Welfare Board 2. Secretary, Department of Commerce 3. Secretary, Department of Financial Services 4. Secretary, Department of Agriculture Cooperation and Farmer Welfare 5. Secretary, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs 6. Secretary, Department of Revenue 7. Secretary, Ministry of Labour and Employment 8. Secretary, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises 9. Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology 10. CEO, NITI Aayog 11. Secretary, DPIIT 12. Finance Wing, DPIIT. 13. Vigilance Desk, DPIIT. 14. PS to CIM. 15. PS to JS (S). 16. NIC, DPIIT with a request to upload the order on the website of DPIIT. 17.
